metrics.name: item_gst_assignment_count
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Item WHERE SalesTaxScheduleCode IS NOT NULL
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.item_tax_assignments a JOIN public.tax_rates t ON t.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND t.branch_id = a.branch_id AND t.id = a.tax_rate_id WHERE a.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND t.tax_kind = 'gst' AND a.source_table = 'Item'

metrics.name: item_pct_assignment_count
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Item WHERE PCTCode IS NOT NULL
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.item_tax_assignments a JOIN public.tax_rates t ON t.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND t.branch_id = a.branch_id AND t.id = a.tax_rate_id WHERE a.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND t.tax_kind = 'pct' AND a.source_table = 'Item'
